See the idea in one answer Illustrative example+

An agent asks

“Anything we should check before approving this pool-deck material?”

An illustration of the response and its evidence, not a live product session.

Wovon’s response

The specified T-440 tile failed under similar conditions at Westfield. Review its suitability with the supplier before approving this bid. [1] [2]

With the newer evidence

The supplier now reports a revised formulation rated for exterior use. The earlier failure concerned the old formulation; confirm which version this bid supplies before relying on the new rating. [2] [3]

Show the receipts ↗
  1. Bid 2291Specifies T-440 porcelain tile for a pool deck.
  2. Westfield maintenance reportRecords a failure of T-440 under similar conditions. The event remains part of the history.
  3. Later supplier noticeReports a reformulated T-440, now rated for exterior use. This new claim applies to the revised formulation.

All records and responses in this example are illustrative.

Fits the way you work

Knowledge your
agents can use.

Build a knowledge model from the material your business works with. Make that understanding available to the people and agents who need it.

The materialDocuments, emails, transcripts and approved system records.
The connectionAgents consult Wovon through MCP. Your applications govern access.
The continuityChange your models and agents. Build on the knowledge you’ve developed.
What is a knowledge model?+

The connected evidence and understanding Wovon develops from your business. Wovon uses AI to keep learning across that record, ahead of questions and through further investigation.

How do agents use Wovon?+

Through MCP, the Model Context Protocol. An agent can consult existing knowledge, inspect its sources or ask Wovon to investigate further. Useful findings can become available for subsequent tasks.

What happens when things change?+

New evidence can change what a conclusion means or whether it still applies. Wovon revisits that understanding while preserving the history and the evidence behind it.
